Corravale University recognizes and values the privacy of its community members and guests. We work to set the standard in the ways we handle your personal information. Reach

Corravale schools, departments, units, clubs, labs, and other groups may keep privacy notices specific to their own collection and processing of your personal information, especially where it differs from the practices set out in this notice.

Information That We Gather

The Corravale website gathers personal information through the following channels:

  • When you provide it to us directly, such as when you subscribe to a newsletter. This information may include your name and contact details.
  • When technology records your information in real time, such as when a small file is stored on your device. Information gathered this way may include:

    • The device's IP address
    • The browser you use
    • The visit's date and time
    • The address of the site that referred you to corravale.edu.
  • Once external advertising and analytics partners, such as PageMetrics, gather your information on our behalf. Examples of the details collected by these external service partners include:

    • Total time spent browsing the site
    • Approximate location from IP address
    • General demographic data
    • Search queries typed into the site.

How Your Information Is Used

Corravale draws on details about how you interact with our website in order to:

  • Keep our website running smoothly by tracking site performance and improving its functionality and overall user experience.
  • Connect more effectively with prospective students and the wider global community by sharing relevant details about university services, events, and academic programs.
  • On occasion we may use personal information for other legitimate and clearly defined purposes. When such cases arise, we will make every effort to notify you.

Parties We Share Your Information With

We neither sell nor rent the personal information collected here. We may share it with service providers that help support our operations and activities. We ask every service provider to keep your personal information secure and to use or share it solely to deliver services on our behalf.

We may also disclose your personal information when the law requires it, or when we believe doing so will help safeguard the safety, property, or rights of the university, members of the university community, and university guests.

Corravale Privacy Notice
Last Revision Date — May 12, 2024
Corravale University recognizes and values the privacy of its community members and guests. We work to set the standard in the ways we handle your personal information. We are dedicated to transparency by helping you understand what personal information we gather, how we make use of it, and when we choose to share it.
At a Glance
If you don’t have time for the full privacy notice below, here is what you should know:
Corravale University is a large institution that operates many different websites. This notice applies to our primary website, corravale.edu. Individual Corravale units and organizations may maintain their own privacy notices.
Our aim is to limit the information we gather to only what we need to support our academic, research, and healthcare missions.
We are committed to using your personal information only for the purposes for which it was originally gathered.
We never sell your personal information, and when we share it beyond Corravale, we do so only to enable operations and services carried out on the university’s behalf, to satisfy legal obligations, or to protect the safety, property, or rights of the university, its community and guests.
We aim to provide you
choices
regarding the personal information gathered on our website.
If you have questions or concerns about your privacy on the corravale.edu website, please contact the
Data Privacy Office
.

privacy overview
outlines the activities carried out across Corravale that involve the gathering and processing of your personal information.
Corravale schools, departments, units, clubs, labs, and other groups may keep privacy notices specific to their own collection and processing of your personal information, especially where it differs from the practices set out in this notice.
Information That We Gather
The Corravale website gathers personal information through the following channels:
When you provide it to us directly, such as when you subscribe to a newsletter. This information may include your name and contact details.
When technology records your information
in real time
, such as when a small file is stored on your device. Information gathered this way may include:
The network domain you use
The device's IP address
The browser you use
The visit's date and time
The address of the site that referred you to corravale.edu.
Once
external advertising and analytics partners
, such as PageMetrics, gather your information on our behalf. Examples of the details collected by these external service partners include:
Pages viewed during the session
Time and date of access
Total time spent browsing the site
Approximate location from IP address
General demographic data
Search queries typed into the site.
How Your Information Is Used
Corravale draws on details about how you interact with our website in order to:
Keep our website running smoothly by tracking site performance and improving its functionality and overall user experience.
Connect more effectively with prospective students and the wider global community by sharing relevant details about university services, events, and academic programs.
On occasion we may use personal information for other legitimate and clearly defined purposes. When such cases arise, we will make every effort to notify you.
Parties We Share Your Information With
We neither sell nor rent the personal information collected here. We may share it with service providers that help support our operations and activities. We ask every service provider to keep your personal information secure and to use or share it solely to deliver services on our behalf.
We may also disclose your personal information when the law requires it, or when we believe doing so will help safeguard the safety, property, or rights of the university, members of the university community, and university guests.
The Choices You Are Able to Make About Your Data
When you browse corravale.edu, “cookies” are stored on your computer or device. Cookies are small files that record information about your visits and interactions with the site. When you access corravale.edu, the cookies below may be placed on your device, depending on your browser settings:

We work to set the standard in the ways we handle your personal information. We are dedicated to transparency by helping you understand what personal information we gather, how we make use of it, and when we choose to share it. At a Glance If you don’t have time for the full privacy notice below, here is what you should know: Corravale University is a large institution that operates many different websites. This notice applies to our primary website, corravale.edu. Individual Corravale units and organizations may maintain their own privacy notices. Our aim is to limit the information we gather to only what we need to support our academic, research, and healthcare missions. We are committed to using your personal information only for the purposes for which it was originally gathered. We never sell your personal information, and when we share it beyond Corravale, we do so only to enable operations and services carried out on the university’s behalf, to satisfy legal obligations, or to protect the safety, property, or rights of the university, its community and guests. We aim to provide you choices regarding the personal information gathered on our website. If you have questions or concerns about your privacy on the corravale.edu website, please contact the Data Privacy Office . Reach This privacy notice explains how we handle personal information gathered on the Corravale primary website (corravale.edu). Corravale schools, departments, units, clubs, labs, and other groups may keep privacy notices specific to their own collection and processing of your personal information, especially where it differs from the practices set out in this notice. Information That We Gather The Corravale website gathers personal information through the following channels: When you provide it to us directly, such as when you subscribe to a newsletter. This information may include your name and contact details. When technology records your information in real time , such as when a small file is stored on your device. Information gathered this way may include: The network domain you use The device's IP address The browser you use The visit's date and time The address of the site that referred you to corravale.edu. Once external advertising and analytics partners , such as PageMetrics, gather your information on our behalf. Examples of the details collected by these external service partners include: Pages viewed during the session Time and date of access Total time spent browsing the site Approximate location from IP address General demographic data Search queries typed into the site. How Your Information Is Used Corravale draws on details about how you interact with our website in order to: Keep our website running smoothly by tracking site performance and improving its functionality and overall user experience. Connect more effectively with prospective students and the wider global community by sharing relevant details about university services, events, and academic programs. On occasion we may use personal information for other legitimate and clearly defined purposes. When such cases arise, we will make every effort to notify you. Parties We Share Your Information With We neither sell nor rent the personal information collected here. We may share it with service providers that help support our operations and activities. We ask every service provider to keep your personal information secure and to use or share it solely to deliver services on our behalf. We may also disclose your personal information when the law requires it, or when we believe doing so will help safeguard the safety, property, or rights of the university, members of the university community, and university guests. The Choices You Are Able to Make About Your Data When you browse corravale.edu, “cookies” are stored on your computer or device. Cookies are small files that record information about your visits and interactions with the site. import re,html,urllib.request,json
def get(u): return urllib.request.urlopen(u).read().decode('utf-8','replace')
t=get('http://localhost:42941/about/privacy/')
i=t.find('id="content"'); j=t.find('id="footer"')
seg=t[i:j]
# extract headings and paragraphs in order
out=[]
for m in re.finditer(r'<(h[1-4]|p|li|h2)>(.*?)</\1>', seg, re.S):
    tag=m.group(1)
    txt=re.sub(r'<[^>]+>',' ',m.group(2))
    txt=re.sub(r'\s+',' ',html.unescape(txt)).strip()
    if txt: out.append({'t':tag,'v':txt})
print(len(out), "nodes")
for o in out[:40]: print(o['t'],'|',o['v'][:100])
json.dump(out, open('/workspace/recreation/src/data/privacy.json','w'), indent=1)
PYEOF
